title: The project settings allow the five scripts the skills tell agents to run, so headless workers are not refused
goal: The project's .claude/settings.json allows Bash(python3 _tools/factdiff.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/kbsettings.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/kbask.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/coord.py *) and Bash(python3 _tools/doc2query.py *) as their skill texts run them, so python3 _tools/backlog.py selfcheck's allow-rules check passes

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import json, subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/backlog.py', 'selfcheck', '--json'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
assert p.returncode in (0, 1) and p.stdout.strip(), ('selfcheck --json', p.returncode, p.stderr[-300:])
checks = {c['name']: c for c in json.loads(p.stdout)['checks']}
assert checks['allow-rules']['state'] == 'ok', ('selfcheck allow-rules', checks['allow-rules']['detail'])

clauses.clause: The project's .claude/settings.json allows Bash(python3 _tools/factdiff.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/kbsettings.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/kbask.py *), Bash(python3 _tools/coord.py *) and Bash(python3 _tools/doc2query.py *) as their skill texts run them, so python3 _tools/backlog.py selfcheck's allow-rules check passes

notes: No other rule of the settings changes: the review reads the diff of .claude/settings.json.
